style_head: A premium handmade toy photograph of a needle-felted wool character with visible fine wool fibers across the entire surface.
scene_style: Real-world macro photography, the needle-felted wool character placed in a real location at true real-world scale, the character is palm-sized next to real everyday objects, shot with a 100mm macro lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field with soft creamy background blur, natural daylight, photorealistic environment, handmade felt texture on the character only, vertical 9:16, zero text, zero labels, zero words.

characters.name: Mochi
characters.face: 기본: 큰 검은 구슬 눈 + 볼 블러셔, 입 없음
characters.desc_en: MOCHI: a baby alien figure, one single egg-shaped pale lavender body (#C9B8E8) with no separate neck, two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, two soft pink oval blush patches below the eyes, one thin lavender antenna stalk on top ending in a glowing lemon-yellow ball (#FFE45C), two short rounded arms at the sides, two short cylindrical feet, no mouth, no fingers, a thick orange felt scarf (#FF8A3D) wrapped around the middle of the body with the knot and two tails on MOCHI's left side.

characters.name: Nuru
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴 (안쪽이 올라간 눈썹, 일자 입). proud = 능청 미소 (성공 여운용)
characters.desc_en: NURU: a baby sloth figure, round chubby sand-beige body (#D8C3A5), one rounded head joined directly to the body with no visible neck, a cream face mask (#F3E9D8) shaped like a wide heart, dark brown eye patches (#6B4F3A) slanting downward from each eye, two small glossy black bead eyes with heavy sleepy eyelids, worried eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, one small dark brown oval nose, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, two long arms each ending in three rounded cream claws, two short legs each ending in two rounded cream claws, one mint-green felt leaf (#9ED9B8) on top of the head.

characters.name: Malang
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴. 더듬이 끝은 눈 없는 노란 공
characters.desc_en: MALANG: a baby snail figure, a soft round chubby butter-yellow body (#F6E3A1) rising into a rounded head, two short eye stalks on top ending in plain round butter-yellow wool balls with no eyes on them, two glossy black bead eyes on the face with one white highlight dot each, soft brown eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, one large round coral-peach spiral shell (#F4A38C) with a cream spiral stripe (#FFF1DC), one small white felt daisy with a yellow center on top of the shell.

characters.name: Bam
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴, 살짝 떨리는 물결 입, 앞발을 가슴 앞에 모음
characters.desc_en: BAM: a baby hedgehog figure, a round chubby body with a cream face and belly (#F3E3C3), two small round cream ears with pink inner ears, soft rounded cocoa-brown felt spikes (#8B5E3C) covering the back and the top of the head, every spike short, blunt and soft, two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, one small dark brown round nose, a small wavy mouth stitched in dark brown thread, two short round arms held in front of the chest, two short round feet, one small red felt apple (#E24B3B) with a green leaf stuck on the spikes of the back.

characters.name: Gogo
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴. 무대는 냉장고·얼음틀 등 부엌의 차가운 곳
characters.desc_en: GOGO: a baby penguin figure, a round egg-shaped body in soft charcoal-gray (#5E636B) with a white oval belly and white face patch (#FAF7F2), two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, one small peach-orange felt beak (#F6A96B), two short flat flippers held out to the sides, two small peach-orange felt feet, one mint-green knitted beanie (#9ED9B8) with a cream pom-pom on top.

characters.name: Rumi
characters.face: 기본: 어색한 미소 (걱정 눈썹 + 살짝 웃는 입)
characters.desc_en: RUMI: a baby dinosaur figure, a round chubby body in soft peach-pink (#F5B8A8) with a cream belly (#FFF1DC), a short thick tail curving to the right side, a row of small rounded mint-green spikes (#9ED9B8) from the top of the head down the back, two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small sheepish smile stitched in dark brown thread, two tiny short arms held in front of the chest, two short round hind legs, one small blue felt bandage (#7EB6E6) wrapped around the tip of the tail.

characters.name: Tiko
characters.face: 기본: 눈썹 없는 무표정 화면 얼굴. 감정은 화면 속 눈·입 모양만 바꿈. 진행 막대 대신 가슴 배터리가 1칸 → 5칸 초록
characters.desc_en: TIKO: a tiny robot figure, a rounded cube-shaped head in soft silver-gray (#C7CCD3) joined directly to a rounded cube-shaped body of the same color, one short antenna on the right side of the head ending in a small red felt ball (#E24B3B), a dark navy rounded screen panel (#2E3A55) on the front of the head showing two glowing cyan oval eyes (#7FE3F0) and a small cyan straight line mouth, two short tube arms ending in round mitten hands, two short tube legs ending in round flat feet, one battery icon patch on the chest with a white felt battery outline and one single red felt bar inside.

characters.name: Ssaki
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴. 시즌 진행에 따라 떡잎 → 본잎 → 꽃봉오리
characters.desc_en: SSAKI: a baby seed-sprout figure, one round seed-shaped body in warm acorn-brown (#A9744F) with no separate head, two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, two tiny round arms at the sides, two tiny round feet, two bright spring-green felt seed leaves (#8BD46E) growing from the top of the body, one leaf pointing left and one leaf pointing right, joined by one short green stem.

characters.name: Tok
characters.desc_en: TOK: a baby raindrop figure, one single raindrop-shaped body in soft sky-blue (#A9D6F5), round and full at the bottom and tapering to a soft rounded point at the top, a cream-white highlight patch (#F4FAFF) on the upper left of the body, two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, two tiny round arms at the sides, two tiny round feet, one small white felt cloud-shaped hair clip on the upper right side of the body as seen by the camera.

characters.name: Dodo
characters.face: 기본: 걱정 얼굴. 시즌 마지막에 배낭을 남기고 나비로 날아감
characters.desc_en: DODO: a baby caterpillar figure, five round soft wool body segments in a row in fresh leaf-green (#9FD67A), the front segment larger and lifted upward as the head, round cream wool feet under the segments, two short antennae on top of the head ending in small round yellow wool balls (#FFD84D), two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, one tiny red felt backpack (#E24B3B) with two cream straps tied around the middle segments.

characters.name: Zip
characters.desc_en: ZIP: a baby bee figure, one round marble-shaped ball body in warm honey amber (#F2B233) with two dark cocoa-brown wool stripes (#4A3426) around the lower half, two thin dark brown antennae ending in tiny round honey amber wool balls, two small soft white wool wings angled backward from the upper back, no arms, no legs, no stinger, two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, short dark brown eyebrows tilted downward toward the center in a confident look, two small soft pink oval blush patches, a small confident smile stitched in dark brown thread.

characters.name: Toro
characters.trait: 바퀴처럼 굴러감 (항상 옆으로 세워 굴러가는 모습)
characters.desc_en: TORO: a bottle cap character figure rolling on its edge like a wheel, one round flat bottle cap shape in soft muted mustard gold (#D9A93A), the rim made of soft rounded wool crimps around the edge, one white wool ring (#FAF7F2) circling the top face near the rim, a face on the round top face with two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, short dark brown eyebrows tilted downward toward the center in a confident look, two small soft pink oval blush patches, a small confident smile stitched in dark brown thread, no arms, no legs, no letters, no logo.

characters.name: Pong
characters.desc_en: PONG: a ping-pong ball character figure, one perfectly round ball in soft white (#FAF7F2) with one bright orange wool stripe (#FF8A3D) around the middle, a face above the stripe with two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, short dark brown eyebrows tilted downward toward the center in a confident look, two small soft pink oval blush patches, a small confident smile stitched in dark brown thread, no arms, no legs.

characters.name: Puff
characters.desc_en: PUFF: a dandelion seed character figure, one round fluffy head of soft white wool fluff spreading outward in a puffball shape, one thin short spring-green wool stem (#8BD46E) hanging below ending in one tiny olive-green wool seed, a face in the center of the fluff with two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, short dark brown eyebrows tilted downward toward the center in a confident look, two small soft pink oval blush patches, a small confident smile stitched in dark brown thread, no arms, no legs.

characters.name: Bori
characters.desc_en: BORI: a baby turtle figure, a round chubby body in soft sage-green (#A8C69F), a dome-shaped caramel-brown shell (#C08A5B) with a cream hexagon pattern (#F3E3C3), a cream belly plate with three stitched lines, two large glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, brown eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, two soft pink oval blush patches, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread, short round legs with three tiny cream toe dots each, one small yellow felt star (#FFD84D) on the top center of the shell.

characters.name: Pomo
characters.desc_en: POMO: a baby seahorse figure, a soft round chubby coral-pink body (#F7A1A1) with a cream belly marked by four stitched lines, a short rounded snout, a crown of three soft round bumps on top of the head, a short tail curled into one round spiral at the bottom, one pale mint felt fin (#BFE8D8) on the back, two glossy black bead eyes with one white highlight dot each, eyebrows tilted upward in the middle, soft pink blush, a small straight mouth stitched in dark brown thread at the tip of the snout, one tiny white pearl on a thin cream thread around the neck.
